messages:
maya: Heads up — PR gating for evals started failing this morning after a credentials rotation. First seen on #pr-1234, blocked job: `gha-eval-runner`

ci-bot: [08:03] gha-eval-runner failed: `401 Unauthorized` when pulling secrets from vault (x3) :x:

maya: stacktrace snippet from the gha logs:
```
ERROR: failed to fetch secret: 401 Unauthorized
at github.com/actions/runner/secrets.fetchSecrets
```

tom: Is this the GH Actions token rotation we did last week? I thought the runner used short-lived tokens via oidc.

anya: We rotated the app credentials for the `eval-runner` service principal on Mon. The Buildkite connector still uses the old app key for artifact upload. GH actions runner uses OIDC but the eval workflow still relies on a cached PAT in secrets.evals.PAT.

sam: Confirmed: `secrets.evals.PAT` was updated, but the GH app integration (we use a bot account for matrix jobs) still points to the deprecated PAT in the repo-level secret `EVAL_RUNNER_TOKEN`. Looks like the repo secret was not updated in the infra repo.

leo: Quick workaround: re-run the job from a repo with the updated secret, or set `EVAL_RUNNER_TOKEN` to the new PAT. But we should stop relying on static PATs — switch to OIDC or federated tokens for both GH and Buildkite.

maya: For immediate unblocking, can someone push a secret to infra repo? I can do it if we confirm the token.

tom: I'll update `infra/ci/secrets` with the new PAT and rotate the repo secret. Doing it now, ETA 10m.

ci-bot: [08:12] Deploy pipeline triggered by tom -> infra/ci/secrets update. 1 changed file.

maya: If anyone's triaging dashboards: the nightly summary shows spike of gate failures starting 08:00 UTC. Might be useful to mute alerts until we confirm.

anya: Noted. Also found a race where runner caches the token in `~/.cache/eval-runner/token.json` and doesn't re-read on 401 — needs a fix so it retries fetching secrets instead of hard-failing.

sam: Filing a quick patch: set token refresh on 401 and add exponential backoff. PR to `infra/eval-runner` coming up.

leo: Also propose GH Actions snippet to switch to OIDC during the job:
```yaml
- name: Exchange OIDC for short-lived creds
  run: |
    aws sts assume-role-with-web-identity --role-arn ${{ secrets.EVAL_ROLE }} --role-session-name gha-eval
```

maya: That would eliminate the need for a PAT. Let's pair on the infra PR.

tom: Updated secret pushed. Re-running the gated PR now.

ci-bot: [08:18] gha-eval-runner retried, now `200 OK` artifact upload. :white_check_mark:

deploy-bot: [08:19] Canary eval: nightly-evals schedule skipped due to transient failures. Resuming.

anya: Followups: (1) infra PR to refresh repo secret automation (2) eval-runner: implement token refresh + backoff (3) migrate to OIDC for both GH and BK connectors (4) add metric `eval_runner_token_age_seconds` to alert if > 1d.

maya: Agreed. I'll create the ticket in our backlog and link the infra PR. Thanks for the fast responses :thumbsup:
